<fidel-select>

Select with search. A native <select>, optionally with a real "Search the list" box that says how many options match.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Screen-reader and keyboard users (a native select), and anyone choosing from a long list.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-select label="Language you prefer" name="language" search>
  <option value="am" lang="am">አማርኛ</option>
  <option value="om">Afaan Oromoo</option>
  <option value="en">English</option>
</fidel-select>

Source: player/src/components/forms/select.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-select>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
labeltextnone (required)The visible label. A placeholder is never used instead of it.
nametextnoneName of the answer when the form is sent.
hinttextnoneHelp text under the label, read with the field.
requiredbooleanoff"(required)" is shown next to the label, and an empty field is an error.
disabledbooleanoffAs on a native field.
describedbyidsnoneIds of your own descriptions, read before Fidel's.
ui-langen, amthe nearest ui-lang, else the page's langLanguage of Fidel's messages (errors, hints).
optionsJSON [{"value","label","lang"}]noneThe options; or child <option> / <optgroup> elements.
searchbooleanoffAdds "Search the list" above the select.
placeholderboolean or textnoneAdds an empty first option, "Choose…" or your own text.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-select>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-field-change{ value, name }The value changed.
fidel-field-invalid{ message, name }The field was checked and is wrong (the message is shown under it).
fidel-field-valid{ name }The field was checked and is right.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Methods and propertiesዘዴዎች እና ባሕሪያት

Methods and properties of <fidel-select>
NameMeaning
valueProperty: the current value.
validityProperty: { valid, message }.
checkValidity()Checks the field, shows the error if there is one, and returns true or false.
focus()Puts focus in the field.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • The browser's own select. The search box keeps the matching options and the number that match is announced.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Messages in English or Amharic (ui-lang); each option can have its own lang.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: A real <label for>; hints and errors are tied to the field with aria-describedby; all in the light DOM.
  • 3.3.1 Error Identification: Errors are in words under the field, which gets aria-invalid. Checked when you leave the field and on submit, never on every key.
  • 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions: A visible label is required; hints say the expected form.
  • 3.3.3 Error Suggestion: Every message says how to fix the problem.
  • 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum): Fields and buttons are at least 44 px tall.
  • 4.1.3 Status Messages: Errors, "Fixed" and other messages are shown and also said through a polite live region.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
